items.title: Holman Bill — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He‟s the brother of Claude Williamson, who is probably a better known player, piano player, younger brother.

ctx.x: Okay. I wanted to look at – the personnel in the band other than Charlie Mariano: Stu Williamson, playing trumpet and trombone – valve trombone, that is. He‟s not a name that we consider a household name. Maybe you could talk a little bit about Stu, because he appears on a lot of sessions and seemed to be working pretty regularly.

Yeah. He was a wonderful jazz player. He didn‟t get a chance to do a lot of recording, but what he did really stood out as a very thoughtful and a very capable player. He‟s the brother of Claude Williamson, who is probably a better known player, piano player, younger brother. Stu I think had a great future, but he was very bashful and very critical of his work and never really happy with it. He got involved with things that he shouldn‟t have, and he died at a very early age.
Was he originally from Los Angeles?
